newsitem.title: USA: Wake County, N.C., approves $428.4 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Wake County, N.C., approves $428.4 million budget.

text.p: North Carolina's Wake County has approved a $428.4 million budget for fiscal 1998, the News & Observer said Tuesday.
The budget leaves the property tax rate unchanged for the third consecutive year, at 63 cents per $100 of assessed value.
It raises overall spending by $25 million over this year, with $18 million of the increase alloted for schools. That puts total school spending at $116.8 million for the year.
